details:
The Martian is an educational adventure game developed for the Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. Players take on the role of an astronaut on Mars, where they must complete mission protocols, collect essential equipment, and solve challenges before beginning their exploration of the planet. The game introduces users to real-world concepts related to space missions, safety procedures, and problem-solving.

The project's main benefit is that it provides a fun and interactive way for young people to learn about space exploration while developing critical thinking and decision-making skills. Its intended impact is to inspire curiosity about science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) and encourage future interest in space-related careers.

The game was developed using Godot Engine, while several 3D models were obtained from Sketchfab's free asset library. This allowed the team to focus on building the gameplay mechanics and educational experience within the available time.

The idea was inspired by reading the ExoMars Programme article about the search for life on Mars. This sparked the creative concept of allowing players to experience the challenges of exploring the Red Planet firsthand. Our team focused on creating an experience that is educational, engaging, and accessible, with the goal of encouraging young people to explore their creativity and imagine themselves as future astronauts and space explorers.
